_meta.method: entry bands from dense h-rule detection (labeling/geometry/entry_bands_draft.json); band->person pairing by READING the birth-date cell and/or name cell on the band and matching to the JUF index per-page child list (name+gebdatum). Label TEXT comes from the index only; reading only LOCALIZES.
_meta.verification: every match below was visually confirmed on full-res cell crops (verification sheets vrf_*.png): g02/g04/g08 by date-cell text, g07/g10 by name-cell text + entry numbering + chronological order.
_meta.held_out: Gerson Mosbacher d.28.05.1845 (s04_22.jpg) never used for training.
